changeWalkthrough.thesis: /flow-next:chart ships decision-map discovery for one oversized unclear idea before capture: a crash-recoverable git-native chart store sharing the spec allocator, an adaptive prompt-first skill that resolves one decision per invocation through the evidence-first routes, a versioned briefing package handed to capture, an optional tracker projection through the fn-141 facade, and the /flow-next:guide router that keeps the whole pipeline a menu rather than a rail. All 55 acceptance criteria carry task coverage; the diff was implemented by grok-4.5 workers under per-wave host review and hardened by six cross-family codex review waves.
